title: lobelia gypsophila
intro: Lobelia gypsophila, commonly known as Lobelia, is a flowering plant in the family Campanulaceae, characterized by its delicate, bell-shaped flowers and slender stems. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to relieve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects, which provide health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Lobelia gypsophila include alkaloids like lobeline and lobelanine, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including bronchodilation and cough suppression. These constituents contribute to the plant's ability to relieve respiratory distress and promote relaxation, making it a popular herbal remedy in traditional medicine.
